groups.activity: kill enemy Necramechs for Matrices; rank Necraloid to 3 (Odima)
groups.meta: T1 drops Orientation, T2 Ballistics, T3 Animus

rows.label: Necraloid Rank 1
rows.note: 5,000 standing, 10 Orientation Matrix, 150 Void Traces, Zymos Barrel Blueprint, 20 Father Tokens

rows.label: Necraloid Rank 2
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 15 Ballistics Matrix, 250 Void Traces, Sepulcrum Barrel Blueprint, 20 Father Tokens

rows.label: Necraloid Rank 3, Odima
rows.note: 44,000 standing, 15 Animus Matrix, 350 Void Traces, Trumna Barrel Blueprint, 20 Father Tokens

conditions: Trade Orokin Matrices to Loid for standing: Orientation 1,000, Ballistics 2,500, Animus 5,000 each.
Higher vault tiers spawn more Necramechs per run (T3 has three), so matrix income speeds up as you rank.
bonuses: Join Sporothrix/Arum Spinosa farm groups, which run vaults constantly.

disclosures.title: go public
disclosures.body: Matchmade vault lobbies are described as trivial; solo stage 1 (residue gathering, bait defense) is where people struggle.

groups.activity: take the Rank 3 reward or buy blueprints, buy the damaged parts

rows.label: Cortege Blueprint
rows.note: free Necraloid Rank 3 pick (competes with Morgha and Necramech mods)

conditions: The Rank 3 free reward is a single pick: take Morgha's blueprint free and buy Cortege's for 8,000 standing, or vice versa.
bonuses: Buying the Damaged parts from Loid skips the 3% rotation-A-only vault RNG entirely.

groups.activity: build the three components, then Cortege
groups.meta: 1,000 cr, 1 min each component; 20,000 cr, 12h main

rows.label: Receiver

rows.label: Cortege Stock
rows.note: 1 Damaged Stock, 80 Tempered Bapholite, 10 Cabochon Embolos, 250 Hexenon

bonuses: A bug where the alt-fire wouldn't charge on kills was fixed in Hotfix 44.0.1: if it recurs, that's a bug, not your build.

disclosures.title: buying instead of farming
disclosures.body: Fully built components are tradeable; trading for them skips the Fersteel Alloy/Ostron Rank 2 requirement entirely.
